hosting.comment: Order matters: when several header rules match one request, Hosting applies the LAST match for a given key. The broad no-cache rule therefore comes first and the immutable overrides follow it.

headers.comment: Default for index.html, sw.js, registerSW.js, the manifest and every SPA route: always revalidate. Firebase's default of max-age=3600 combined with the PWA precache left users on a stale build for up to an hour after a deploy, security fixes included. no-cache still allows a cheap 304 via ETag; it does not mean 'do not store'.
Vite content-hashes everything under /assets, so a given URL never changes contents and can be cached forever.
